steps: Light the firewood to one side of the grate and let it burn down to embers, about forty minutes.
Mix the parsley, garlic, oregano, vinegar, oil and chilli flakes; the chimichurri needs an hour to stand.
Rake a thin layer of embers under part of the grate and lay on the sausages; they go first.
Salt the ribs coarsely all over and lay them bone side down over a moderate heat.
Cook the ribs bone down for two hours, adjusting the embers so a palm can stay above the grate for seven seconds.
Turn the ribs and give them forty minutes meat side down, for a crust.
Add the flank for the last twenty minutes, rest the meat ten and serve it with the chimichurri.
